title: Book Three · Chapter 200: The Last Saturday at Home
story:
On Saturday morning, Ronan walks to the workshop with Dad.

His travel bag is ready at home. Today he has come to say goodbye, not to begin another paid shift.

The counter helper is finding a customer's cover. She looks up and smiles.

“Tomorrow?”

“Seven.”

She nods toward the papers. “I can still find your little questions.”

Ronan smiles. Her drawings are on the outside of the covers, his old question headings inside.

Mr Sun comes forward from the bench. Ronan thanks him for the work and the time to learn it.

“You did the mornings and the long weeks,” Mr Sun says.

“And bought a very small library.”

Mr Sun laughs. Dad sets his work bag down and goes to the measuring table.

There is still an ordinary working day ahead for the others. Ronan shakes Mr Sun's hand and leaves before the next customer reaches the counter.

At the green door, Mr Qiu is setting out pencils. Ronan stops to tell him the departure time.

“A new desk,” Mr Qiu says.

“And more paper.”

Mr Qiu gives him a quick smile. A customer asks for a notebook, and Ronan moves aside so she can reach the stall.

Inside, Mum is finishing the last part of his packing. His blanket and sheets are folded around the basin. The soap is wrapped separately.

He puts one of his five old story books in the cloth book bag. The other four are on his shelf.

The birthday book goes beside the story, with its class photo and Leo's address still inside. His phrase book and roof bookmark come too. He puts Anna's first school letter beside her birthday note in the cloth case.

Mum checks the travel bag's handles. Ronan lifts it once, then puts it down beside the door.

In the yard, the blue bike stands against the wall. He touches the old bell but does not take it off.

Dad comes home for lunch and sees him there.

“I will keep it ready,” he says.

“You can use it. It is still mine.”

Dad nods. “Still yours.”

That evening, the three have dinner together. Mum gives Ronan a small packet of bread and fruit for tomorrow's journey. Dad fills his water bottle before bed.

Ronan puts the food in his cloth bag. He leaves the ticket and documents ready where he can reach them.

Before the light goes out, he looks once more at the four books on his shelf. Then he lies down beneath the familiar window for his last night before the journey.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

heading＝栏目标题；handle＝提手；separately＝分开放置；document＝需要携带的正式纸件。

## 理解问题

1. 哪些书随身走、哪些留家？旧铃有没有拆走，蓝车有没有送给Dad？
2. Mr Sun、前台、Dad和Mum是否停止自己的生活来围着Ronan？今天是否有新工资？

## 读句子

**The other four are on his shelf.**

拆开看：The other four / are / on his shelf.

另外四本旧书／留在／他自己的书架上。
